title: Introduce service operator certification and residency enforcement gate
author: Jordan Park
description:
Summary: This PR introduces an operator certification workflow and a residency enforcement gate that ties RBAC v2 role resolution to certified operator attributes and per-request residency claims. Motivation: incidents where cross-region operator actions accidentally provisioned KMS keys or modified audit retention for tenants in restricted jurisdictions exposed a gap between role binding metadata and runtime enforcement. The goal is to ensure only certified service operator principals can perform region-unrestricted KMS operations and to add stronger audit provenance for every operator-mediated KMS interaction. What changed (high level): 1) New RBAC v2 templates: added two new role profiles 'operator.certified' and 'operator.trainee' and a policy translation helper that maps certification attributes into runtime allow/deny decisions. 2) Residency enforcement gate: a middleware placed in front of KMS allocation and key-usage APIs that verifies a per-request residency_claim (geozone tag) and cross-checks the operator.certified attribute. Requests lacking matching certification or a valid residency claim are denied with a clear error (403 + audit hook). 3) Audit enrichments: every operator-mediated KMS request now attaches an immutable audit token (audit.origin.signature) and a residency-evidence hash. Audit tokens are HMAC-signed and stored in the audit log entry header, enabling downstream verifier services to detect tampering. 4) KMS usage meter: lightweight counters and cost-labels added to tag KMS calls that required residency overrides so finance/ops can reconcile exceptions. 5) Tests and docs: unit tests and integration scenarios covering v2 policy resolution, residency mismatch flows, and audit token verification. Linear/JIRA: relates to ENG-2389 (operator-role-hardening) and SEC-104 (audit-provenance).

Small illustrative snippet (residency gate behavior): "if !operator.Certified || residencyClaim == missing -> return 403 with audit.reason='missing_cert_or_residency'"

Review conversation (high level):
- Maya Singh (reviewer): "Thanks Jordan — overall looks good. Please add a short migration note for existing operator bindings and include rollout steps for Dedicated clusters."
- Jordan Park (author): "Added migration note and dedicated-cluster rollout section in docs; added a feature-flag check for < 1% sampling during initial rollout."
- Ethan Chen (reviewer): "Can we avoid synchronous HMAC signing on hot paths? Suggest batching sign operations and validating in background for non-critical ops."
- Jordan Park: "Addressed: switched signer to a fast HMAC using keyed SHA256 and added a non-blocking cache for signatures on repeated operator IDs. See certify.go changes."
- Priya Rao (security): "Please ensure audit token secrets are rotated and that rotation is logged. Also confirm that PII is not materialized in audit token."
- Jordan Park: "Rotation hooks added; token contains only operator_id, residency_hash, timestamp and signature (PII-free). Added audit tests to assert no PII in payloads."

Approvals and gating:
- Security approval (Priya Rao) recorded after token rotation tests passed.
- SRE signoff (Maya Singh) for Dedicated rollout strategy.
- CI: all checks green after two reruns (lint -> flake fix applied).

CI details:
- build: pass
- unit-tests: pass
- integration-tests: pass (residency scenarios)
- lint: pass (one run had gofmt warning, fixed)

Rollout notes and migration:
- Feature-flag controlled rollout (operator_cert_gate) to allow gradual enforcement. Default off for the first week in production while sampling and monitoring metrics.
- Migration script added to map existing operator role bindings to operator.certified where operator metadata has 'certified:true' in LDAP/IDP.
- For Dedicated customers: a per-cluster toggle with operator audit-forwarder enabled during cutover.

Monitoring and alerts:
- New SLO: percentage of operator KMS requests with audit.origin.signature present (target 100%).
- Alert: >0.1% of operator KMS calls denied for missing residency during rollout triggers PagerDuty to the sec-oncall rotation for investigation.

Release notes: "Add operator certification and residency enforcement gate: strengthens RBAC v2 decisions for operator principals, attaches immutable audit provenance to operator KMS activity, and introduces KMS usage labels for exception reconciliation. Feature-flag guarded for staged rollout."

Backwards compatibility: calls without residency_claim continue to function while feature-flag is off; once enforced, calls will be rejected until repaired.

Testing: unit tests added for policy compiler translation, residency mismatch flows, and audit-token verification. Integration test exercises a simulated operator with and without certified attribute across three geozones (us, eu, apac).

Risk and mitigations: Risk: rollout could break automation that assumes operators have unlimited KMS permissions. Mitigation: feature-flag + sampling + migration mapping + ops runbook.

Related work: follow-up PR planned to add UI in Console to show operator certification status and to provide self-service certification requests (ENG-2450).
